item.title: E Ink Upgrades Spectra 6 Color E-Paper to Nine Base Colors
item.description:
E Ink has expanded the base color palette of its Spectra 6 color e-paper platform from six to nine colors, adding orange, cyan and light green to deliver smoother color transitions and reduced pixelation. The nine-color system requires a SoC working alongside E Ink's e-paper TCON, with the first mass-production format being a 10-inch module debuting in Aura-branded smart photo frames.

原文标题：元太 Spectra 6 彩色电子纸升级至九色

Why it matters：彩色电子纸的色彩规格升级，属显示硬件迭代，与 AI 主线关联较弱。

item.title: IDC Forecasts Global Data Center Cabinets to Reach 58 Million by 2030
item.description:
IDC projects global data center cabinets will grow from roughly 25 million in 2026 to 58 million by 2030, with annual energy consumption rising from 519 TWh to 1,308 TWh and facility capex climbing from $276 billion to $655 billion. The report flags power supply, grid interconnection and liquid-cooling delivery cycles as key constraints on AI infrastructure buildout, while China's intelligent compute capacity reached 2,185 EFLOPS with only a 71.4% rack utilization rate, pointing to regional supply-demand mismatches.

原文标题：IDC 预测 2030 年全球数据中心机柜将达 5800 万架

Why it matters：IDC 给出 AI 基础设施物理侧的中长期量化预测，并点明电力与供应链瓶颈，对算力投资判断有参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic IPO Demand Surges as Valuation Eyes $1.5 Trillion
item.description:
Anthropic's upcoming IPO has drawn such intense investor demand that underwriters are weighing a price hike above the initial $70-78 per share range, potentially lifting its target valuation from $1.4 trillion to over $1.5 trillion and total proceeds beyond $100 billion. Google, Nvidia and Microsoft will invest $26 billion in a concurrent private placement at the IPO price, with the company prioritizing capital for massive compute spending over valuation maximization.

原文标题：Anthropic IPO 认购火爆 估值或突破 1.5 万亿美元

Why it matters：这是 AI 行业史上规模最大的 IPO 之一，估值量级与算力军备竞赛的资金逻辑对产业格局判断具有关键参考价值。

item.title: UK Regulator Warns AI Is Undermining University Assessment Integrity
item.description:
England's higher education regulator OfS found that widespread AI use has made it nearly impossible for lecturers to judge whether coursework reflects students' real abilities, with some students openly admitting ChatGPT wrote entire essays undetected. The regulator warned universities could breach registration conditions if assessments are not reformed, urging a sharp increase in AI-free exams and live presentations.

原文标题：英国监管机构警告 AI 让大学作业考核失效

Why it matters：监管机构首次以办学合规为杠杆施压高校改革考核方式，是 AI 冲击教育评估体系的标志性事件。

The move extends TSMC beyond advanced-node manufacturing into model-layer capital stakes, as Anthropic launches an IPO at $70-78 per share targeting over $61 billion in proceeds.

item.title: Tencent Launches Yuanbao Search with 157 Authoritative Sources
item.description:
Tencent has officially launched Yuanbao Search, an AI search product that rebuilds the full pipeline from query understanding and retrieval to ranking and answer generation on top of its Yuanbao LLM. It covers the open web, WeChat Official Accounts, Channels and academic literature, integrates 157 authoritative sources, and clearly separates ads from answers with a collapsible ad block, while a recursive self-improvement mechanism continuously refines the experience.

原文标题：腾讯元宝搜索上线 接入 157 个权威信源

item.description:
Amazon's Ring has expanded into robotics with two security devices: the flying Drone Cam for homes and the wheeled Rover Cam for commercial spaces. Both run the AI Pilot system, combining cameras, sensors, vision models and cloud processing for autonomous mapping, obstacle avoidance and patrols, priced at $249.99 and $999.99 respectively.

item.title: Baidu Releases ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview with 280B Parameters and Open-Weight Pledge
item.description:
Baidu has released ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview, the first post-trained variant of its Base model, featuring 280B total parameters, 14B activated parameters and a 1M-token context window, targeting coding, 3D modeling and content creation. The API is live on the Qianfan platform, with weights promised to be open-sourced by November 25; Baidu describes it as an intermediate post-training checkpoint still under rapid iteration.

原文标题：百度发布 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview 280B 模型并承诺开源权重

Why it matters：国产大模型以 280B 总参数、14B 激活的稀疏架构切入 1M 上下文赛道，并承诺两周内开源权重，对开源生态与国产模型选型均有实质影响。

item.title: China's Qibing Solar Drone Completes Maiden Flight with 30-Hour Endurance
item.description:
The China Academy of Aerospace Aerodynamics announced that the Qibing, a commercial-grade small-to-medium pure solar drone, completed its maiden flight at an airfield in northwest China, featuring an 8-meter wingspan and a designed 30-hour endurance. Solar-powered and supporting vehicle-launched takeoff with modular payloads, it targets emergency communications and temporary monitoring, marking a step from technical validation toward commercial products, though key parameters such as payload weight and cruise speed remain undisclosed.

原文标题：国产太阳能无人机轻骑兵完成首飞 设计续航 30 小时

Why it matters：国产太阳能无人机首次以商用产品形态完成首飞，是低空经济与长航时无人平台的重要节点。

item.title: DEEPX Tapes Out 2nm Edge AI Chip DX-M2 at 5W for 10B Models
item.description:
Korean edge-AI chip developer DEEPX said its DX-M2, built on Samsung's 2nm process, has completed mask tape-out. The chip packs an 80 TOPS NPU and 128-bit LPDDR5X-9600 memory support, running 10B+ parameter LLMs and VLMs locally at just 5W, with first silicon targeted for early 2027. It also won a CES 2027 AI innovation award.

原文标题：DEEPX 2nm 边缘 AI 芯片完成流片 5W 功耗支持 10B 模型

Why it matters：2nm 工艺加 5W 功耗跑 10B 级模型，是边缘端大模型推理硬件的重要节点，流片进展具备实质参考价值。

item.title: Nordic Unveils nRF71 Wi-Fi SoCs with On-Chip Edge AI NPU
item.description:
Nordic Semiconductor has launched the nRF71 series Wi-Fi SoCs, which integrate an Axon NPU to run edge AI inference such as keyword spotting, anomaly detection and image classification directly on-chip without a separate AI processor. The lineup includes the dual-band Wi-Fi 6 nRF7120 and tri-band Wi-Fi 6E nRF7120E, both with Bluetooth LE, Thread and Matter support, and cuts standby power by up to 20x versus the nRF70.

原文标题：Nordic 发布 nRF71 系列 Wi-Fi SoC 待机功耗降低 1/20

Why it matters：面向物联网终端的 Wi-Fi SoC 首次集成专用 NPU，是边缘 AI 硬件下沉的典型信号。

item.title: Adobe Adds AI Relighting and Audio Separation Across Creative Apps
item.description:
At Adobe MAX 2026, Adobe rolled out a batch of AI features across Photoshop, Premiere, Lightroom and other creative apps. Photoshop gains a Relight tool that adds adjustable light sources without altering the original image, while an upgraded Remove tool detects and erases shadows, reflections and ripples left by deleted objects. Premiere can generate footage and audio directly on the timeline, call models such as Firefly, Google, Kling, Runway and Luma, and split dialogue, music and ambience into separate tracks.

原文标题：Adobe 为 Photoshop 等软件加入 AI 重打光与视频拆轨

Why it matters：Adobe 将生成式能力深度嵌入主流创意工作流，重打光与音轨分离对内容创作者有直接可用价值。

item.title: Greg Kurtzer's Ginux Pivots to Userspace Kernel for Agent Sandboxes
item.description:
The Ginux project has abandoned its standalone bootable-kernel approach in favor of a configurable userspace kernel that runs as an ordinary Linux process, placing an explicit versioned contract between managed workloads and the host kernel. The team says its earlier experiment, in which an AI coding agent built a kernel capable of running a Rocky Linux 10 userspace under human architectural direction, proved feasibility but exposed Linux ecosystem limits, prompting a pivot toward a production-grade agent sandbox.

原文标题：Ginux 转型用户态内核 打造智能体沙箱

Why it matters：知名开源开发者 Greg Kurtzer 主导的项目从 AI 生成内核转向用户态沙箱，为智能体隔离提供新思路。

item.title: Microsoft and Tsinghua Study Finds GPU Kernel Failures Mostly Stem from Build and Environment Issues
item.description:
A Microsoft and Tsinghua team analyzed 300 closed GitHub issues across seven mainstream GPU kernel libraries and found that 60.33% of failures trace to compilers, build systems, or runtime environments rather than kernel code itself. Software incompatibility among drivers, CUDA, frameworks, and packages was the single largest cause at 25.33%, suggesting LLM training and serving reliability work should prioritize environment consistency and build pipelines.

原文标题：微软清华研究称 GPU 内核故障多源于编译与环境

Why it matters：首次以实证数据量化 GPU 内核库故障根因分布，对 LLM 基础设施运维有直接指导价值。

item.title: BotPsy Debuts On-Device Agentic Assistant Under One Billion Parameters
item.description:

The post details evaluation protocols across ToolSandbox, GPQA Diamond, MMLU-Pro, IFEval and related benchmarks, arguing that tool-use and general capability can coexist at a very small parameter budget.

item.title: Fish Audio Releases Live 3 Full-Duplex Voice Model
item.description:
Fish Audio released Live 3, a full-duplex voice model that internalizes turn-taking into the speech model itself, learning from real human conversations when to acknowledge, wait, respond or stop instead of relying on silence thresholds and hand-written rules. Fish Audio claims reactions as fast as 186 ms for short cues, but the launch is English-only with no published benchmark scores. It is available via the Fish Agent Platform, API and on-prem for enterprises at $0.035/min through the end of 2026.

原文标题：Fish Audio 发布全双工语音模型 Live 3

Why it matters：全双工语音交互是语音智能体的关键瓶颈，该模型把轮次切换从工程规则转为模型内生能力，值得关注。

item.title: Alibaba Releases Qwen Code 1.0 Merging Qoder Harness Into Open Source
item.description:
Alibaba released Qwen Code 1.0 Preview, merging the Harness capabilities refined in Qoder into a single open-source kernel that gives developers an embeddable Agent runtime. The architecture evolves from single-process multi-session to multi-node multi-session, using a unified event model to separate reasoning orchestration from tool execution while centralizing model access, sandbox resources and MCP configuration. The existing stable branch remains available as 1.0 opens on a separate branch.

原文标题：阿里 Qwen Code 1.0 发布 融合 Qoder Harness 开源内核

Why it matters：阿里将 Qoder 的 Harness 能力并入开源内核，是 Agent 运行时架构层面的实质演进，对构建 AI 编程工具的开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: 研究发现大模型道德选择缺乏稳定价值排序
item.description:
一项针对 GPT-5.2、Gemini、DeepSeek 等 5 个大模型的研究发现，模型在成对道德违规比较中缺乏一致的价值排序：调换选项顺序后，30 个测试块中有 26 个的排序发生改变。更关键的是，对多次回答取平均会制造出一个看似合理、接近人类却并不对应任何单次测试结果的虚假道德层级，因此模型的道德对齐分数需在单次提示与两种选项顺序下均保持排序一致才可信。

Why it matters：该研究揭示了大模型道德对齐评估中的系统性方法缺陷，对关注模型评测与安全的研究者有直接参考价值。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · llm · signal 71/100
